title: Omniprediction for All Mixable Proper Losses and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2610.41023v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omniprediction concerns the task of making predictions that are simultaneously accurate with respect to different losses. Earlier results by [CV09] show that in an online learning setting, $O(\log(|\mathcal{F}||\mathcal{L}|))$ regret is achievable simultaneously against every predictor in a finite predictor class $\mathcal{F}$ and for every loss in a finite class $\mathcal{L}$ of mixable proper losses, while recent advances [OKK25, FP26] show that $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T\log(|\mathcal{F}||\mathcal{L}|)})$ regret is achievable simultaneously for every loss in a finite class $\mathcal{L}$ of bounded losses.   In this work, we ask whether sublinear regret remains possible when $\mathcal{L}$ is an infinite class of proper losses. Our first result gives a negative answer in general: even when $\mathcal{F}$ contains only two linear predictors, it is impossible to achieve sublinear regret simultaneously for all bounded proper losses. translated_title: 面向所有可混合恰当损失及更广泛情形的全能预测
translated_abstract: 全能预测关注的是如何做出在不同损失下都能同时保持准确的预测。早期结果 [CV09] 表明，在在线学习设定下，对于有限预测器类 $\mathcal{F}$ 中的每个预测器，以及由可混合恰当损失构成的有限类 $\mathcal{L}$ 中的每种损失，可以同时实现 $O(\log(|\mathcal{F}||\mathcal{L}|))$ 的遗憾；而最近的进展 [OKK25, FP26] 表明，对于由有界损失构成的有限类 $\mathcal{L}$ 中的每种损失，可以同时实现 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T\log(|\mathcal{F}||\mathcal{L}|)})$ 的遗憾。在本工作中，我们探究当 $\mathcal{L}$ 是无限恰当损失类时，次线性遗憾是否仍然可能实现。我们的第一个结果给出了一般情形下的否定答案：即使 $\mathcal{F}$ 仅包含两个线性预测器，也不可能对所有有界恰当损失同时实现次线性遗憾。随后我们展示……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明当损失类扩展为无限类时，全能预测的次线性遗憾一般无法实现——即使预测器类仅含两个线性预测器，也不可能对所有有界恰当损失同时达到次线性遗憾，从而为该问题给出否定答案。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that sublinear regret for omniprediction is generally impossible when the loss class is infinite: even with only two linear predictors, one cannot achieve sublinear regret simultaneously for all bounded proper losses, giving a negative answer.
